title: Normal subgroups and factor groups
summary: Subgroups whose left and right cosets agree; equivalent characterisations of normality by conjugation; the factor group G/N with its well-defined multiplication and order [G:N]; examples and non-examples; the simplicity of A_n for n ≥ 5.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 10 of Judson (Sections 10.1–10.2).

preparation.description: Read Section 10.1: normal subgroups (Theorem 10.1.3) and factor groups (Theorem 10.1.4) with examples.
Read Section 10.2 (the simplicity of the alternating group) from the chapter page.
Optional supplement: MIT student notes, lecture 6 (Normal Subgroups and Quotient Groups).
